 If you’ve been keeping up with Black Friday 2026 sales like we have, a new sale seems to drop every day. Even though Black Friday isn’t until next week — November 27th — SO many brands have already put early deals live, like Zara , Walmart , Lululemon , and Nordstrom . Just recently (like today!), one of our favorite brands dropped their Black Friday event and it’s one we guarantee you’ll want to shop as well. Coach Outlet’s Black Friday Sale for 2026 is finally here with major discounts and an extra 25% off! 
 How to Save an Extra 25% Off During Coach Outlet’s Black Friday Sale 
 As part of Coach Outlet’s Black Friday event, they’re offering an extra 25% off hundreds of select styles. which you can find here . There are over 400 items currently eligible for that extra 25% off, including the Sydney Shoulder Bag ($164, originally $350), the fan-favorite Rowan Satchel ($217, originally $289), and the City Tote Bag ($172, originally $295). They even have cozy cold weather gear up for grabs, along with bags and accessories for the men in your life . There’s no code needed to activate the extra 25% off. Prices will be automatically adjusted at checkout.

 As mentioned before, there are over 800 items on sale right now as part of Coach Outlet’s Black Friday 2026 sale . If you’re wondering what you might be able to expect, check out a few of our top picks below.

 The Rowan Satchel Bag 30 is a beloved style that many Coach fans have claimed as their “go-to.” Not only that, it sells out all the time in different colors. Fortunately, it’s pretty well stocked right now and included in Coach Outlet’s Black Friday sale.

 Coach Outlet’s Maggie Tote Bag in Signature Leather is the type of chic work bag that you carry to show that you totally have your life together (even if you feel like you don’t!). It’s spacious enough to fit an iPad, a Kindle, and a laptop up to 15 inches. Plus, it’s originally priced at over $400 and on sale for less than $200 right now.

 The City Tote Bag is a Coach Outlet classic and a wardrobe staple for Coach fans. It’s super roomy, with enough space to fit your laptop, tablet, notebooks, water bottle, and pretty much anything you might need for the day ahead. Right now, it’s even available in 10 colors, so you’re sure to find one that fits your needs and aesthetic.

 If you’re looking for that one bag you can bring along for running errands or going on a date night, one fellow Coach Outlet shopper says this is it. Many love how small and cute it is (note the sizing as it is on the smaller side). “I’m a big bag girl and don’t own many small bags at all but I LOVE this one,” wrote one reviewer. It comes in five colors. 
 Coach Outlet Black Friday 2026: Best Deals 
 Corner Zip Wristlet In Signature Canvas With Stripe 
 $29

 Buy Now 
 We can’t talk about a Coach Outlet event without highlighting one of their fan-favorite wristlets . They’re great for gifting to friends due to their under-$30 price tag. Plus, there are 20 different colors and patterns to choose from! So many great options. 
 How Long Will Coach Outlet’s Black Friday Sale Last? 
 Coach Outlet ‘s Black Friday deals — at least the extra 25% off — will run from today, November 18th to December 1st at 11:59 p.m. ET. While that does give you quite a bit of time to get your shopping in, popular styles and colors may sell out. In fact, we’ve seen a few sold-out items already! With that said, you don’t have to wait until next week to score some incredible savings on Coach Outlet. Be sure to check out their Black Friday event today. 
 Will Coach Outlet Have Doorbuster Deals on Black Friday? 
 As of now, we don’t have any info on official doorbuster deals at Coach Outlet. We’ll be sure to let you know and keep you updated if and/or when that changes. 
 Will Coach Outlet Have a Cyber Monday Sale? 
 Since Coach Outlet’s extra 25% off promotion runs through the Tuesday after Thanksgiving, it’s highly likely this will be their Cyber Monday deal as well. Once again, we’ll be bringing you all the latest updates on Coach Outlet’s Black Friday and Cyber Monday deals for 2026, so stay tuned.
